record.what_it_does: Salesforce B2C Commerce (Commerce Cloud) is an enterprise ecommerce platform whose Commerce API (SCAPI) exposes RESTful Shopper APIs (browsing, cart, checkout) and Admin APIs (product, order, inventory management) for a merchant's storefront instance.
record.auth_notes: Shopper APIs use SLAS (Shopper Login and API Access Service, OAuth 2.1) via a SLAS client to get a JWT access token; Admin APIs use an Account Manager-issued API client with OAuth2 client-credentials grant against oauth2/access_token. Both deliver a JWT used as a Bearer token on requests. Not user-delegated OAuth in the classic third-party sense — auth is client/application-level, scoped per B2C Commerce instance.
record.access_notes: There is no public self-serve signup: 'Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud does not offer public free trials or playground environments for individual users. Access is strictly reserved for existing customers and official Salesforce partners.' A public read-only demo sandbox (org f_ecom_zzte_053) exists for trying Shopper API calls in docs, but real Admin/Shopper credentials for one's own data require an existing paid B2C Commerce license (customers get on-demand sandboxes via Account Executive) or Partner Community access.
record.main_blocker: No self-serve API credentials; requires an existing paid B2C Commerce license or Salesforce partner status to provision a real instance/sandbox
